title: It's 'time to jump in' with Palantir and these 2 stock picks
title_zh: 是时候加入 Palantir 和这两只精选股票了
summary: Gibbens Capital president and chief investment officer Mark Gibbens chats with Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton about three stock picks he's keeping an eye on: Palantir (PLTR), Nvidia (NVDA), and JPMorgan (JPM).
summary_zh: Gibbens Capital 总裁兼首席投资官 Mark Gibbens 与雅虎财经的 Josh Lipton 讨论了他关注的三只股票：Palantir (PLTR)、Nvidia (NVDA) 和 JPMorgan (JPM)。

title: Bitcoin Ticks Up Even as Trump’s Iran War Threats Cloud Markets
title_zh: 尽管特朗普的伊朗战争威胁云市场，比特币仍在上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Bitcoin rose in early trading Monday as investors weighed reports that Iran was seeking a ceasefire in the war, even as US President Donald Trump escalated threats to attack civilian infrastructure.The original cryptocurrency was up as much as 2.8%, trading arou...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——比特币周一早盘上涨，投资者权衡了有关伊朗正在寻求战争停火的报道，尽管美国总统唐纳德·特朗普升级了攻击民用基础设施的威胁。最初的加密货币上涨了 2.8%，交易量约为 2.8%。

title: Stock market today: US stock futures rise as hopes emerge for a Mideast end to hostilities
title_zh: 今日股市：随着中东结束敌对行动的希望出现，美国股指期货上涨
summary: Reports of a ceasefire proposal are lifting hopes for an end to US-Iran hostilities.
summary_zh: 有关停火提议的报道正在提升结束美伊敌对行动的希望。

title: Inflation readings, oil volatility, and airline earnings: What to watch this week
title_zh: 通胀数据、石油波动和航空公司盈利：本周值得关注的内容
summary: Inflation readings, Delta earnings, and more Middle East volatility are set to headline the week ahead.
summary_zh: 通胀数据、达美航空盈利以及更多中东波动将成为未来一周的焦点。

title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Sales Meet Estimates on Solid AI Demand
title_zh: Nvidia 合作伙伴鸿海的销售额符合人工智能强劲需求的预期
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a 29.7% rise in quarterly sales, a sign of sustained AI demand during the first weeks of war in the Middle East.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——鸿海精密工业有限公司公布季度销售额增长 29.7%，这表明中东战争头几周人工智能需求持续增长。

title: Foxconn first-quarter revenue jumps, company cautions on geopolitics
title_zh: 富士康第一季度营收大幅增长，公司对地缘政治发出警告
summary: Taiwan's Foxconn, the world's largest contract electronics maker, reported a 29.7% on-year rise in first-quarter revenue ‌on strong demand for artificial intelligence products, though it cautioned ‌about "volatile" global politics.
summary_zh: 全球最大的合同电子产品制造商台湾富士康报告称，由于对人工智能产品的强劲需求，第一季度收入同比增长 29.7%，不过该公司对“不稳定”的全球政治发出了警告。
